trickyParts: A variable the image's ENV sets is one runtime.kubernetes.pod.env is refused (sandbox/operatorpod.go imageEnv, held to the Dockerfile by TestImageEnvIsWhatTheWorkerImageSets), so the image sets no PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH: Oh My Pi finds /usr/bin/chromium on PATH itself before any download (its Kpe/Udr/Xdr resolution, read from the pinned bundle), and the operator's pod env naming another browser is what the probe runs, which the Stage 4a image-probe-capability-negative check drives
typescript-language-server wraps tsserver, which TypeScript 7 (npm latest, 7.0.2, bin tsc alone) no longer ships, so TypeScript is pinned to the repository's own 5.9.3

record.Notice gained a slice field (openCapabilities), so every `==`/slices.Equal on notices panics at runtime (CI caught hold_test.go after local Postgres-less runs skipped it); comparisons are reflect.DeepEqual now
The OK line's existing mark parsers anchored agent-models to daemon-api-version=; the new marks sit between them, and one markPattern builder tolerates marks a line lacks (an older CLI's) or adds
The probe pod's log tail was 50 lines; the table adds 19 before the OK line, so probeLogLines is 100

Oh My Pi's profile-root resolution (OMP_PROFILE/PI_PROFILE, PI_CONFIG_DIR, XDG_DATA_HOME, PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR) lived only in the boot gate; the probe's plugin-lock check now reads it through the new internal/ompdirs rather than a second simplified port
